description: This file defines classes that extend grain states with versioning and metadata, including ETag, serialization, and utility methods, for use within Orleans framework's event sourcing persistence model.

classes.name: GrainStateWithMetaDataAndETag
classes.description: A class extending grain state with versioning and ETag metadata, supporting log-view consistency.

classes.name: GrainStateWithMetaData
classes.description: A class extending grain state with metadata such as versioning and write vector, used for log consistency in Orleans.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the grain state with metadata and ETag.

methods.name: GetBit
methods.description: Retrieves the bit value for a specific replica from the write vector.

methods.name: FlipBit
methods.description: Toggles the bit for a specific replica in the write vector and returns the new bit state.
